database_summary: This SQLite database contains ~50k alien-related rows, political legislators and terms, city/country/currency/language dimensions, job postings with companies and skills, and several dimension tables for dates and skills. Data is a mix of entity/dimension tables (descriptive attributes), fact/event tables (job_postings_fact, legislators_terms), and bridge tables (skills_job_dim). Several tables use repeated ids across related tables that allow joins but may multiply rows (e.g., skills_job_dim many-to-many). Temporal columns exist mainly as YYYY-MM-DD or timestamps. The dataset appears denormalized in places (alien_data duplicates attributes found in aliens, aliens_location, aliens_details).

accepted.name: job_postings_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  j.job_id,
  j.company_id,
  c.name AS name,
  c.link AS link,
  c.link_google AS link_google,
  c.thumbnail AS thumbnail,
  j.job_title_short AS job_title_short,
  j.job_title AS job_title,
  j.job_location AS job_location,
  j.job_via AS job_via,
  j.job_schedule_type AS job_schedule_type,
  j.job_work_from_home AS job_work_from_home,
  j.search_location AS search_location,
  j.job_posted_date AS job_posted_date,
  j.job_no_degree_mention AS job_no_degree_mention,
  j.job_health_insurance AS job_health_insurance,
  j.job_country AS job_country,
  j.salary_rate AS salary_rate,
  j.salary_year_avg AS salary_year_avg,
  j.salary_hour_avg AS salary_hour_avg,
  s.skill_id AS skill_id,
  sd.skills AS skills,
  sd.type AS type
FROM job_postings_fact j
LEFT JOIN job_company c
  ON j.company_id = c.company_id
LEFT JOIN skills_job_dim s
  ON j.job_id = s.job_id
LEFT JOIN skills_dim sd
  ON s.skill_id = sd.skill_id
accepted.description: Denormalized view of job postings joined to company and skill details. Useful when you need job postings with company metadata and associated skills per posting. Each row is one job posting + one skill (if any). | Use for: Top-K jobs by salary (join and then rank/filter by salary); Jobs with specific skills or skill types; Company-level summaries of job counts or average salaries; Distributions of remote vs on-site jobs by skill

accepted.name: job_postings_posted_date_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  job_id,
  company_id,
  job_title_short,
  job_title,
  job_location,
  job_posted_date,
  job_country,
  salary_year_avg,
  salary_hour_avg,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_id ORDER BY job_posted_date DESC) AS posting_rank_by_job,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY job_posted_date DESC) AS global_posted_rank
FROM job_postings_fact
accepted.description: Per job (job_id) ranking of postings by job_posted_date, exposing a recency rank. Useful for retrieving the latest posting per job_id or finding recent postings across jobs. | Use for: Get latest posting per job (WHERE posting_rank_by_job = 1); Recent job postings across the board (filter global_posted_rank <= K); Time-based analyses of salaries using latest posting per job

accepted.name: legislators_current_terms
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id_bioguide,
  term_number,
  term_id,
  term_type,
  term_start,
  term_end,
  state,
  district,
  class,
  party,
  how,
  url,
  address,
  phone,
  fax,
  contact_form,
  office,
  state_rank,
  rss_url,
  caucus
FROM legislators_terms
accepted.description: One row per legislator term including term temporal bounds and descriptive attributes. Useful as a base to filter current/active terms or to analyze term durations by state/party. | Use for: Find current/active legislators by comparing term_start/term_end to a given date; Aggregate terms by state or party; Join to legislators entity table to enrich with personal attributes

accepted.name: legislators_latest_term_per_bioguide
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  lt.id_bioguide,
  lt.term_number,
  lt.term_id,
  lt.term_type,
  lt.term_start,
  lt.term_end,
  lt.state,
  lt.district,
  lt.class,
  lt.party,
  lt.how,
  lt.url,
  lt.address,
  lt.phone,
  lt.fax,
  lt.contact_form,
  lt.office,
  lt.state_rank,
  lt.rss_url,
  lt.caucus,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lt.id_bioguide ORDER BY lt.term_start DESC) AS term_rank_per_bioguide
FROM legislators_terms lt
accepted.description: Latest term per legislator (id_bioguide) based on term_start. Exposes rank so downstream queries can select the most recent term per legislator. | Use for: Get current/latest term for each legislator (WHERE term_rank_per_bioguide = 1); Compare career lengths or party changes using latest terms; Join latest term to legislators for up-to-date biography + contact

accepted.name: cities_population_by_country
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  country_code_2,
  COUNT(city_id) AS city_count,
  SUM(population) AS total_city_population,
  AVG(population) AS avg_city_population,
  MAX(population) AS max_city_population,
  MIN(population) AS min_city_population
FROM cities
GROUP BY country_code_2
accepted.description: Aggregated city-level population measures per country_code_2. Useful to compare countries by total and average city population and to find largest cities. | Use for: Rank countries by total city population; Find countries with largest average city size; Identify countries with a single dominant city (max vs avg)

accepted.name: aliens_denorm_latest_locations
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  ad.id,
  ad.first_name AS first_name,
  ad.last_name AS last_name,
  ad.email AS email,
  ad.gender AS gender,
  ad.type AS type,
  ad.birth_year AS birth_year,
  ad.age AS age,
  ad.favorite_food AS favorite_food,
  ad.feeding_frequency AS feeding_frequency,
  ad.aggressive AS aggressive,
  ad.occupation AS occupation,
  ad.current_location AS current_location,
  ad.state AS state,
  ad.us_region AS us_region,
  ad.country AS country,
  al.loc_id AS loc_id,
  al.current_location AS loc_current_location,
  al.state AS loc_state,
  al.country AS loc_country,
  al.occupation AS loc_occupation,
  adt.detail_id AS detail_id,
  adt.favorite_food AS detail_favorite_food,
  adt.feeding_frequency AS detail_feeding_frequency,
  adt.aggressive AS detail_aggressive
FROM alien_data ad
LEFT JOIN aliens_location al
  ON ad.current_location = al.current_location
LEFT JOIN aliens_details adt
  ON ad.favorite_food = adt.favorite_food AND ad.feeding_frequency = adt.feeding_frequency
accepted.description: Combine alien_data with aliens_location and aliens_details where possible to create a denormalized alien record including location and feeding details. Each row is one alien_data.id (preserves id) and may include matching loc and detail attributes when names/ids match. | Use for: Profile aliens with both location and feeding/aggression attributes; Resolve discrepancies between denormalized alien_data and normalized location/details; Filter aliens by state/occupation/feeding attributes

accepted.name: cities_country_latest_insert_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  city_id,
  city_name,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  country_code_2,
  capital,
  population,
  insert_date,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date DESC) AS city_rank_in_country
FROM cities
accepted.description: Rank cities within each country by insert_date (most recent first). Exposes city_rank_in_country for selecting newest cities per country. | Use for: Get most recently inserted cities per country; Find newest capitals or largest recent additions

accepted.name: skills_usage_counts
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.skill_id,
  sd.skills AS skills,
  sd.type AS type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.job_id) AS jobs_with_skill
FROM skills_job_dim s
LEFT JOIN skills_dim sd
  ON s.skill_id = sd.skill_id
GROUP BY s.skill_id, sd.skills, sd.type
accepted.description: Counts of how many job postings mention each skill. Useful to find most common skills across job postings and to join back to skill metadata. | Use for: Top skills by number of job postings; Skill demand trends when combined with posting dates; Filter jobs by high-demand skills
